validationRules: Never override or move original plot episode locations and times to create the cross-society scene.
Presence envelopes and open schedules are not confirmed free-time. Do not treat zero timed overlap as proof of attendance.
If two scenes share a person and travel cannot be completed between them, cancel/shift the NEW society candidate, not the pre-existing scene.
Shreya is never placed at two locations at once; Sat and Sun evening only, no Monday compulsory outing.
Home/childcare for Tara, Vihaan and Anaya must be agreed; otherwise downgrade a full-group event to subset.
Romantic contact and knowledge ledgers are initial plot intentions; optional private kiss is not yet canon.
Rerun collision and commute checks if any earlier approved EP06 timeline gets revised.
